name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.1 degrees north of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 11 times in 5 visits over 31 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 21 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 31 hours starting 2025-11-18, at wavelengths from 0.90 to 4.38 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
